title: LG TV will not power on
shortDescription: TV unresponsive with no standby LED.
fullDescription:
When an LG TV will not power on at all, the most common cause is a failed power supply board (PSU), particularly the capacitors on the 5V standby rail.

If the standby LED isn't lit, suspect the PSU. If the LED is lit but the TV won't fully start, the main board or panel could be at fault.
symptoms: TV doesn't react to remote or button

fixSteps.title: Verify outlet
fixSteps.instruction: Plug a lamp into the same outlet to confirm power.

fixSteps.title: Power drain
fixSteps.instruction: Unplug 5 minutes, hold power button 30 seconds.

fixSteps.title: PSU capacitor check
fixSteps.instruction: Open back, look for bulged caps on PSU.

whenToCallPro: If you can't safely discharge capacitors or identify the failed component.
videoSearchQuery: LG TV won't turn on power supply fix

faq.q: Is it safe to open the TV?
faq.a: PSUs hold dangerous voltage - drain caps and unplug for hours before touching.

title: WebOS interface frozen on splash screen
shortDescription: TV boots but WebOS doesn't respond.
fullDescription:
An LG TV that powers on but freezes on the WebOS logo or home screen usually has a corrupted firmware or full system cache. Hard reset clears most cases; severe corruption needs USB recovery.

Newer WebOS versions (22+) added an emergency boot mode triggered by holding power 10 seconds at boot.

fixSteps.title: Hard reset
fixSteps.instruction: Unplug 5 minutes, hold power 30 seconds, replug.

fixSteps.title: USB firmware update
fixSteps.instruction: Download firmware from LG support, copy to USB, plug in.

fixSteps.title: Service reset
fixSteps.instruction: Hold Settings on remote until red dot appears, enter service menu (last resort).

whenToCallPro: If USB recovery fails - main board may need replacement.

faq.a: USB updates preserve data; factory reset will sign you out.

title: Persistent ghost image on OLED panel
shortDescription: Static UI elements leave faint traces on screen.
fullDescription:
OLED burn-in shows as faint persistent ghosts of frequently displayed elements (news tickers, channel logos, HUDs). Image retention is temporary; true burn-in is permanent.

LG provides Pixel Refresher routines to mitigate retention, but heavy burn-in may require panel replacement.
symptoms: Faint logos visible on solid color

fixSteps.title: Run Pixel Refresher
fixSteps.instruction: Settings > General > OLED Care > Pixel Refresher (4-6 hours).

fixSteps.title: Lower OLED light
fixSteps.instruction: Settings > Picture > OLED Pixel Brightness 70 or below for static content.

fixSteps.title: Vary content
fixSteps.instruction: Avoid hours of static UI; use screen savers.

whenToCallPro: Burn-in covered under LG warranty in some regions; check before paid repair.
videoSearchQuery: LG OLED burn in pixel refresher

faq.a: It removes most temporary retention but not permanent burn.

title: HDMI input shows no signal
shortDescription: TV does not detect signal from HDMI source.
fullDescription:
LG WebOS TVs commonly fail HDMI handshakes when HDMI Deep Color is incorrectly set, when sources connect via cheap cables, or when CEC re-initializes after sleep.

For 4K@120Hz with HDMI 2.1 (gaming), Ultra High Speed certified cables are required.
symptoms: Works on some HDMIs not others

fixSteps.title: Switch input
fixSteps.instruction: Press Input button, select correct HDMI.

fixSteps.title: Enable HDMI Deep Color
fixSteps.instruction: Settings > General > Devices > HDMI Settings > HDMI Deep Color ON for that port.

fixSteps.title: Replace cable
fixSteps.instruction: Use Ultra High Speed HDMI for 4K/120 sources.

whenToCallPro: If specific port has physical damage.
videoSearchQuery: LG TV no signal HDMI fix

faq.q: Why does HDMI 1 work but HDMI 2 doesn't?
faq.a: Ports may have different settings; enable Deep Color on each.

title: HDCP handshake failure
shortDescription: Copy-protected content won't play through HDMI.
fullDescription:
LG WebOS TVs require successful HDCP authentication for streaming, Blu-ray, and other protected sources. Failures cause black screen or repeated reconnects.

Most common with AVRs in pass-through mode or with old cables that don't carry HDCP signaling reliably.

fixSteps.title: Power cycle chain
fixSteps.instruction: Unplug TV, AVR, source 60 seconds.

fixSteps.title: Bypass AVR
fixSteps.instruction: Connect source directly to TV.

fixSteps.title: Replace cable
fixSteps.instruction: Use a known-good Premium High Speed or Ultra High Speed cable.

faq.q: What HDCP version does my TV have?
faq.a: All LG 4K TVs since 2016 support HDCP 2.2; 8K/HDMI 2.1 sets support 2.3.

title: Magic Remote pointer / pairing failure
shortDescription: Pointer doesn't work or remote unpaired.
fullDescription:
Magic Remote uses RF (Bluetooth) for pointer/voice and IR for basic commands. When pairing breaks, the pointer and Magic features stop working but power may still respond.

Re-pair by pointing remote at TV and pressing the wheel/OK button until paired indicator shows.

fixSteps.title: Replace batteries
fixSteps.instruction: Two AA alkaline.

fixSteps.title: Re-pair
fixSteps.instruction: Point at TV, press OK/wheel until 'Registration complete' appears.

fixSteps.title: Reset Bluetooth
fixSteps.instruction: Hold Back + Home for 5 seconds to unpair, then re-pair.

videoSearchQuery: LG Magic Remote not working pair

faq.q: Can I use any LG Magic Remote?
faq.a: Most are cross-compatible with WebOS 3.0+; pair as above.

title: Netflix unable to connect on LG TV
fullDescription:
TVQ-ST-103 / TVQ-NW-* errors mean Netflix can't reach servers from the TV. Most cases are local network problems; sometimes the Netflix app needs reinstalling.

This appears across LG WebOS TVs, especially with custom DNS or VPNs.

fixSteps.title: Test other apps
fixSteps.instruction: Open YouTube to confirm internet works.

fixSteps.title: Restart Netflix
fixSteps.instruction: Quit and relaunch; if persists, reinstall.

fixSteps.title: Reset network
fixSteps.instruction: Settings > Network > Forget Wi-Fi, reconnect.

faq.a: Yes - have your Netflix credentials ready.

title: TV plays picture but no audio
shortDescription: Internal speakers or audio output not working.
fullDescription:
Picture without sound on LG WebOS TVs is often an audio output setting (HDMI ARC, optical, headphones) routing audio away from internal speakers, or a Dolby Atmos passthrough mismatch.

Less commonly the audio amp on the main board fails - this requires a board swap.

causes.cause: Atmos passthrough not supported by source

symptoms: Volume bar moves but no sound

fixSteps.title: Check sound output
fixSteps.instruction: Settings > Sound > Sound Output - select TV Speaker.

fixSteps.title: Set Audio Format
fixSteps.instruction: Sound > Advanced > Digital Audio Out - try PCM.

fixSteps.title: Sound test
fixSteps.instruction: Settings > Support > Sound Test runs internal speaker test.

whenToCallPro: If sound test fails - hardware fault.

faq.q: Why does sound only fail on Netflix?
faq.a: App passes Atmos that TV can't decode - set output to PCM.

title: Sound plays but screen is black
shortDescription: Backlight or T-CON failure with audio still working.
fullDescription:
Black screen with sound on an LG LCD/NanoCell points to backlight failure - the panel works but isn't illuminated. With OLEDs it suggests T-CON or pixel-array issue.

A flashlight test on LCD: shine into screen at angle - if you see a faint image, backlight is dead.

fixSteps.title: Flashlight test
fixSteps.instruction: Shine bright light at screen; if faint image visible, backlight failed.

fixSteps.title: Power cycle
fixSteps.instruction: Unplug 5 minutes, hold power 30 seconds.

fixSteps.title: Service repair
fixSteps.instruction: Backlight LED replacement or T-CON board swap.

whenToCallPro: Backlight repair requires panel disassembly - call a pro unless experienced.
videoSearchQuery: LG TV black screen sound flashlight test

faq.q: Is it worth repairing on small TVs?
faq.a: Often not - repair cost approaches replacement on sub-50 inch sets.

title: Lip sync mismatch with soundbar or apps
shortDescription: Audio leads or lags behind video.
fullDescription:
LG WebOS provides AV Sync Adjustment for both internal and external audio. Lip sync issues are common with eARC soundbars after firmware updates.

Using PCM audio and Auto Power Sync off can stabilize sync.

fixSteps.title: AV Sync slider
fixSteps.instruction: Settings > Sound > Advanced > AV Sync Adjustment.

fixSteps.title: Switch to PCM
fixSteps.instruction: Settings > Sound > Digital Sound Out > PCM.

fixSteps.title: Disable game mode
fixSteps.instruction: Game mode reduces processing - test with it off if used.

faq.q: Why is sync different per app?
faq.a: Each app encodes differently - per-app adjustment isn't possible, find an average.

title: SimpLink HDMI-CEC failure
shortDescription: Connected devices don't respond to LG remote / TV.
fullDescription:
SimpLink is LG's HDMI-CEC implementation. When it fails, devices don't power on with the TV, the TV remote doesn't control connected gear, or input switching breaks.

Firmware updates sometimes disable SimpLink - check it after every WebOS update.

fixSteps.title: Enable SimpLink
fixSteps.instruction: Settings > General > Devices > HDMI Settings > SimpLink ON.

fixSteps.title: Enable on partner
fixSteps.instruction: Anynet+ on Samsung, Bravia Sync on Sony, Viera Link on Panasonic.

fixSteps.title: Power cycle chain
fixSteps.instruction: Unplug all devices 60 seconds, power on TV last.

faq.q: Does SimpLink work with non-LG devices?
faq.a: Yes - HDMI-CEC is a standard, just under different names.

title: WebOS firmware update did not complete
shortDescription: Update download or install fails repeatedly.
fullDescription:
WebOS updates can fail due to network instability, full storage, or server-side issues during a phased rollout.

USB recovery using firmware downloaded from LG's support site usually works when OTA fails.

fixSteps.title: Wired connection
fixSteps.instruction: Connect Ethernet for stable update.

fixSteps.title: Free storage
fixSteps.instruction: Uninstall unused apps.

fixSteps.title: USB update
fixSteps.instruction: Download firmware from LG support; place in /LG_DTV/ folder on USB.

whenToCallPro: Only if USB recovery also fails.
videoSearchQuery: LG WebOS update failed USB fix

faq.a: LG Support site - search exact model number.
